name: list_kms_issuers
description:
Retrieve the list of KMS issuers that belong to the authenticated team. The results are paginated.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/kms/issuers --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

limit.description: Maximum number of issuers to return.

next.description: Continuation cursor to retrieve the next page of results.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
